mainText: Good morning. Futures are drifting lower this morning on AI sell-off worries. The S and P 500 is down seven tenths of a percent, the Nasdaq 100 is down one and a half percent, and the Dow is down a tenth of a percent. The ten year Treasury yield is about 5.14 percent, down about two basis points from Friday's close of 5.15 percent. Biggest premarket movers: Nvidia is down 3.8 percent ahead of earnings tomorrow and on reports the board may oust its chief executive. Coinbase is down 7.4 percent and Robinhood is down 6.1 percent on crypto weakness. Coherent is down 6.4 percent, Micron is down 6.1 percent, and CoreWeave is down 8.1 percent in the AI chip sell-off. On the upside, Centene is up 3.3 percent, Take-Two is up 2.5 percent, and Kimco is up 2.4 percent.
